QUOTE: "Single token, unread corpus holds a match | "NOT DEFINITIVE… the name exists… ask dossier"" and "Single token, no unread-corpus hits, file docs present | "definitive empty result… do not retry""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer shows definitive-for-scope and not-definitive cases, but it never states a "definitive for a reason that is not absence" grade (for example, definitive because the scope or something else rules out an answer). The "NOT DEFINITIVE… name exists" row says the name exists, so it is a non-definitive result, not a distinct third grade.
